HEXWORLD.RegenSettlements: Regenerate settlements, POIs and road network (replaces the current ones)
HEXWORLD.ToolSite: Place settlement or point of interest (pick the type in the palette)
HEXWORLD.ToolRoadMinor: Trace path: click origin, then click destination
HEXWORLD.ToolRoadMajor: Trace road: click origin, then click destination
HEXWORLD.SyncJournal: Publish to journal: create/update pages for named features and map notes over the sites
HEXWORLD.JournalSynced: Journal synced: {pages} new pages, {renamed} renamed, {notes} map notes.
HEXWORLD.LoreCityOpen1: {name} is a walled city of merchants and artisans whose gates rarely close before nightfall.
HEXWORLD.LoreCityOpen2: Few markets in the region rival those of {name}, where caravans arrive from every road.
HEXWORLD.LoreCityOpen3: {name} grew from a humble crossroads into one of the great cities of the land.
HEXWORLD.LoreVillageOpen1: {name} is a quiet village where everyone knows everyone else's business.
HEXWORLD.LoreVillageOpen2: Travelers speak of {name} as a welcome sight after long days on the road.
HEXWORLD.LoreVillageOpen3: Little happens in {name}, and its people prefer it that way.
HEXWORLD.LoreSettleCoast1: Salt wind and gull cries fill its streets: the sea shapes every trade here.
HEXWORLD.LoreSettleCoast2: Its harbor shelters fishing boats by dawn and traders' sails by dusk.
HEXWORLD.LoreSettleRiver1: It stands on the banks of the {river}, whose waters bring both trade and trouble.
HEXWORLD.LoreSettleRiver2: Ferrymen and millers make their living from the {river} that runs past its walls.
HEXWORLD.LoreSettleLake1: Its people fish the still waters of a nearby lake and watch the mists that rise from it.
HEXWORLD.LoreSettleLake2: The lake at its doorstep provides fish, reeds and more than one local legend.
HEXWORLD.LoreSettleInland1: It lies far from open water, surrounded by {biome} in every direction.
HEXWORLD.LoreSettleInland2: The surrounding {biome} provides for its people, though the nearest port is many days away.
HEXWORLD.LoreSettleRealm1: It owes fealty to {realm}, whose roads bind it to the wider land.
HEXWORLD.LoreSettleRealm2: Royal banners fly over its gates ({realm}), a reminder of where its loyalties lie.
HEXWORLD.LoreSettleWild1: No crown claims it: it stands alone in the wilds, governed by its own council.
HEXWORLD.LoreSettleWild2: It lies beyond the borders of any realm, and its people answer to no distant throne.
HEXWORLD.LoreSettleHook1: Lately, travelers whisper of strange lights on the roads after dark.
HEXWORLD.LoreSettleHook2: The local inn pays well for news from afar — and better for escorts willing to travel.
HEXWORLD.LoreSettleHook3: Something has been taking livestock at night, and nobody agrees on what it is.
HEXWORLD.LorePoiNear1: It lies within reach of {nearest}, whose people know this place well and avoid it after dark.
HEXWORLD.LorePoiNear2: Folk from {nearest} sometimes come this way, though few linger past sunset.
HEXWORLD.LorePoiRemote1: This place lies far from any settlement, in lands where travelers are rare.
HEXWORLD.LorePoiRemote2: Only the determined reach this place: no road comes anywhere near it.
HEXWORLD.LorePoiTerrain1: The surrounding {biome} hides it from all but the most careful eyes.
HEXWORLD.LorePoiTerrain2: Maps mark little else here: {biome} stretches away in every direction.
HEXWORLD.LoreHookDungeon1: Rumor holds that its depths were never fully explored — nor emptied.
HEXWORLD.LoreHookDungeon2: Old bounties on whatever sleeps below have never been claimed.
HEXWORLD.LoreHookDungeon3: Every few winters, someone ventures inside and does not come back.
HEXWORLD.LoreHookTemple1: Pilgrims still come on holy days, though fewer with every passing year.
HEXWORLD.LoreHookTemple2: The keepers of this place are said to guard more than relics.
HEXWORLD.LoreHookTemple3: Offerings left here are never seen again — believers call that proof enough.
HEXWORLD.LoreHookRuin1: Nobody remembers who built it, and the stones themselves offer no easy answers.
HEXWORLD.LoreHookRuin2: Scavengers pick through the rubble by day; by night, wiser people stay away.
HEXWORLD.LoreHookRuin3: Half-buried carvings hint that something important happened here, long ago.
HEXWORLD.LoreHookMarker1: This place is known to locals, though maps rarely name it.
HEXWORLD.LoreHookMarker2: Whatever happens here, it is worth remembering the way back.
HEXWORLD.LoreRiverCourse1: The {name} winds from its highland springs down through the lowlands to its mouth.
HEXWORLD.LoreRiverCourse2: Boats can work long stretches of the {name}, though its upper reaches run fast and shallow.
HEXWORLD.LoreRiverMouthSea1: Its waters reach the sea at last: {mouth}.
HEXWORLD.LoreRiverMouthLake1: Its course ends in still waters: {mouth}.
HEXWORLD.LoreRiverMouthGeneric1: Its waters run to the open sea beyond the charted map.
HEXWORLD.LoreRiverTowns1: Settlements have grown along its banks: {towns}.
HEXWORLD.LoreRiverEmpty1: No settlement of note stands on its banks — its valleys remain wild.
HEXWORLD.LoreSeaOpen1: An inland sea spreads here, and sailors tell many stories about it; few agree on which are true.
HEXWORLD.LoreSeaOpen2: Its waters are deep enough for true ships, and its storms deserve respect.
HEXWORLD.LoreLakeOpen1: Its still surface hides cold depths that local fishers treat with care.
HEXWORLD.LoreLakeOpen2: Mist gathers over the water at dawn, and with it more than one old tale.
HEXWORLD.LoreWaterShore1: Folk have settled along its shores: {towns}.
HEXWORLD.LoreWaterWild1: No settlement stands on its shores; its waters belong to the wilds.
HEXWORLD.LoreRealmOpen1: Its roads and laws radiate from its capital, {capital}.
HEXWORLD.LoreRealmOpen2: Power here rests in {capital}, where the court gathers and the levies are counted.
HEXWORLD.LoreRealmLand1: Most of its territory is {biome}, dotted with villages that feed its towns and keep its roads alive.
HEXWORLD.LoreRealmLand2: Beyond its farms and roads, much of the land is still {biome} where the crown's writ runs thin.
HEXWORLD.LoreRealmNeighbors1: It shares uneasy borders with its neighbors: {neighbors}.
HEXWORLD.LoreRealmAlone1: No other realm borders it: wilderness surrounds its lands on every side.
HEXWORLD.IconMenuHint: Pick the icon used to draw each site type on HexWorld maps and in the editor palettes. Scope: world (all players see it).
HEXWORLD.BiomeArtMenuHint: Pick the image tile drawn inside every cell of each biome. Browse to use your own art, or revert a biome to its flat color or to the packaged default. Scope: world (all players see it).
HEXWORLD.BiomeArtFlatTip: Use the flat color instead of artwork
HEXWORLD.UseBiomeArtHint: Draw the configured artwork tiles on the terrain view instead of flat colors (this client only).
HEXWORLD.ToolRename: Rename (click a site, river, lake or sea)
HEXWORLD.ToolLabelMove: Move label (drag a label; right-click = automatic position)
HEXWORLD.RealmDeleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Its territory becomes wilderness. This cannot be undone (it also clears the undo history).
HEXWORLD.RealmCreated: Realm founded: paint its territory with the realm brush.
HEXWORLD.RealmNoneSelected: Select a realm in the palette first.
HEXWORLD.RealmLimit: No room for more realms (254 max).
HEXWORLD.ToolRealm: Paint realm territory (pick the realm in the palette)
HEXWORLD.RouteAnchorSet: Origin set — click the destination to trace the route.
HEXWORLD.RouteUnreachable: No traversable route to that point.
HEXWORLD.ToolRiverAdd: Add river (springs where you click, flows to the sea)
HEXWORLD.ToolRiverRemove: Remove river (downstream from where you click)
HEXWORLD.SeaLevelHint: Re-freezes the sea level for the whole scene: coastlines will move. Painted edits (elevation, biomes, rivers) are preserved.
HEXWORLD.NoWorld: Press “Generate preview” to create a world.
HEXWORLD.StatsSummary: {cells} cells · {land}% land · {rivers} river cells · {lakes} lake cells
HEXWORLD.ErrGenerate: HexWorld: error during generation. Check the console (F12).
HEXWORLD.ErrTooManyCells: Too many cells ({n}). Maximum is {max}: reduce columns or rows.
